🇷🇺 Failed AFU assault on Toretsk exposed A Ukrainian media investigation reveals a disastrous May 2025 offensive where the AFU launched two waves into near-liberated Toretsk. A column of 21 vehicles (including Bradley BMPs) with over 100 troops from the 100th Separate Mechanised Brigade entered the city; only 14 returned. Trapped without supplies, soldiers survived on captured Russian stockpiles while drones dropped ammunition. Reinforcements suffered further losses, including two burned Bradleys. At least 86 personnel are confirmed dead or missing between May 6-10. Despite the fiasco, key commanders were promoted rather than punished. The operation reportedly aimed to pin down Russian forces away from Konstantinovka, but resulted in heavy casualties for minimal gain. @Slavyangrad

Latvia has showcased naval drone catamarans previously tested in Ukraine during its Independence Day parade in Riga. Four unmanned maritime platforms developed by Latvian company NEWT21 appeared in the parade for the first time: two FOG boats and two RAY catamarans. The RAY catamarans can carry aerial drones, underwater vehicles, and evacuation equipment, while the FOG boats are designed for high-speed autonomous operations. Both models have been in serial production since August. NEWT21 said the vessels are intended to strengthen Latvia’s autonomous capabilities in the Baltic Sea.
